question: Quel fournisseur a le montant TTC total le plus élevé ?
sql_raw_extracted:
SELECT 
    ds.supplier_name,
    SUM(fi.total_amount) AS total_ttc
FROM 
    fact_invoice fi
JOIN 
    dim_supplier ds ON fi.supplier_id = ds.supplier_id
GROUP BY 
    ds.supplier_name
ORDER BY 
    total_ttc DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Quels taux de TVA sont appliqués dans les factures, et combien de fois chacun est-il utilisé ?
sql_raw_extracted:
SELECT 
    dv.vat_rate,
    COUNT(fi.invoice_key) AS nombre_de_factures
FROM 
    fact_invoice fi
JOIN 
    dim_vat dv ON fi.vat_id = dv.vat_id
GROUP BY 
    dv.vat_rate
ORDER BY 
    dv.vat_rate;
sql_executed:
SELECT 
    dv.vat_rate,
    COUNT(fi.invoice_key) AS nombre_de_factures
FROM 
    fact_invoice fi
JOIN 
    dim_vat dv ON fi.vat_id = dv.vat_id
GROUP BY 
    dv.vat_rate
ORDER BY 
    dv.vat_rate
LIMIT 1000
answer_raw: Dans les factures, le taux de TVA de 7% est appliqué dans 10 factures, tandis que le taux de TVA de 19% est appliqué dans 7 factures.

question: Quel est le montant TTC total par mois (année et numéro de mois) ?

SELECT 
    d.month AS mois,
    d.year AS annee,
    SUM(f.total_amount) AS montant_ttc_total
FROM 
    fact_invoice f
JOIN 
    dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY 
    d.month, d.year
ORDER BY 
    d.year, d.month;
sql_executed:

    d.month AS mois,
    d.year AS annee,

    d.month, d.year

    dim_supplier s ON fi.supplier_id = s.supplier_id

    COUNT(fi.invoice_key) > 1;
